problem: Does the signed pair consisting of coherence activation at one grade and observation residue at the next assemble into a canonical chain boundary?
bold_conjecture: The local balance pairs are isolated cancellation identities with no common global incidence complex.

definitions.zero_cells: v_j represented by grade projector P_j
definitions.one_cells: e_j represented by the extension from grade j to j+1
definitions.face_typing: source face is ternary coherence coefficient -P_j; target face is unary observation coefficient +P_(j+1)

acceptance_tests: every local signed pair is one boundary column
kernel in degree one is zero
prefix extension appends one row and one boundary column without changing old incidence
claim_boundary: Exact finite cellular identification of the staggered residue family with the oriented interval boundary. This supplies incidence and connectedness, not physical space, physical time, or a nonidentity homotopy.
